decisions.statement: A credential file is named `.credentials.json` inside the directory that file is given.
A write of an empty access token or an empty refresh token leaves the file as that file is.
A write keeps every key the file already held beside its `claudeAiOauth`.
A written file is readable by the owner and by nobody else.
A refresh takes the credential the account's page has and asks nothing of the network.
A refresh whose page credential expires no later than the file's leaves the file as that file is.
A credential that has already expired is not written to the file.
A credential expiring inside the reader's buffer is written.
The lateness is said.
A refresh that faults is said and thrown on rather than swallowed.
A push whose credential resolves to an upstream account another page is pinned to is refused.
A push that is refused throws rather than answering that the push happened.
A file naming no `claudeAiOauth` is not pushed to the page.
A run of writes settles for two seconds before one push is made of that run.
The watch asks the file system every three seconds whether the file moved.
A file that cannot be read or parsed or that names no expiry reads as no expiry.
A write the watch made itself is not pushed back to the page.
An empty file is never pushed.
A file whose expiry moved out is pushed even for an account the caller says to skip.
A stopped watch leaves neither a poll nor a pending push behind.
Nothing here says a line except through a door.
A refusal to write an empty token is silent.
The writer takes no door.

definition: the credential file a signed-in agent reads, kept level with the account's page
